summary: Tested v2.4 Twilio SMS send helpers + /notifications/sms-test guardrails (backend) and Settings > Notifications SMS UI (frontend). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_v24_sms_test_guardrails.py with 17 tests — all pass. Verified: (a) POST /api/notifications/sms-test returns 400 with detail 'Turn on SMS reminders first.' for the applereview account which is NOT opted in (proving is_configured() is True — not 503); (b) endpoint requires auth (401 without token); (c) normalize_us_phone: '(844) 697-7111'->'+18446977111', '8446977111'->'+18446977111', '+18446977111'->'+18446977111', '18446977111'->'+18446977111', 'bad'/None/'' -> None; (d) _build_sms_body produces 'CheerPlanner: N upcoming reminder(s).' + up to 3 '- ' item lines + optional '...and N more.' + 'Reply STOP to opt out.'; (e) GET/PATCH /api/notifications/preferences round-trip sms_enabled/sms_phone/sms_consent_at without opting in. Frontend on /settings/notifications: SMS section renders, notif-sms-phone + notif-sms-consent visible, notif-sms-test button correctly hidden when SMS OFF and appears when consent toggled ON (button was NOT tapped — no real SMS sent). Toggled consent back OFF, then cleanup PATCH cleared sms_phone/sms_consent_at so the applereview account remains not-opted-in and clean. No red screen; no page errors; email frequency + category toggles still work.
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.tsx normalizePhone(): 'Send me a test text' will show even if the user typed an invalid phone earlier, because backend accepts any string in sms_phone via PATCH (no server-side normalize_us_phone validation on save). The sms-test endpoint does validate with normalize_us_phone (returns 400 'Add a valid US mobile number first.'), so functionally safe, but consider server-side normalization on PATCH for a cleaner stored value.

core/sms.py normalize_us_phone: for '+' inputs it only checks len(digits) >= 11 — a very long garbage string like '+abc12345678901' would still normalize. Minor; acceptable for a helper that gates on downstream Twilio validation.

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 after re-run; 1 flaky network timeout on first attempt)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI assertions passed, no real SMS sent)
